title: Chemical Notices from Foreign Sources: Atomic Weight of Uranium
version: Chemical News 27, 22, 10 January 1873; Wellcome Library public-domain scan
lineage: Contemporaneous English report of the original German paper, not the full paper or meeting minutes. The preceding printed p. 21 gives the issue date.

passages.note: Printed p. 22 / source PDF p. 28: report of Rammelsberg’s 1872 Berichte paper about Mendeleev’s proposed uranium correction and resulting analogies.

file.method: Selected pages extracted without changing page content using pdfseparate/pdfunite; corresponding raster renders checked against the complete source. Source-page numbering counts the original PDF from one.
